title: Board Runtime
plain_reading: A board result means the package loaded, ran, and reported what happened on a real setup.
what_this_supports: When present, it can support a measured latency claim for that exact board, firmware, package, and setup.
what_this_does_not_prove: Runtime alone does not prove energy savings, thermal behavior, task accuracy, or production readiness.
next_actions: Add live board execution service when prototype hardware exists.
